notes.title: Trivia: Chemistry & Uncommon Words 3 are here!
notes.content: [h2]Hi there, master codebreakers[/h2][hr][/hr][p]We recently enjoyed the new Tivia: Physics and Quotes Pack 5 DLCs, and we are not slowing down! Today we come to you with another batch of tricky messages to decode, this time from the fields of Chemistry and Uncommon Words. Can you handle the new challenges? Will you be able to decipher the new, interesting passwords? Well - there is only one way to find out! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465938/9ab43f55aab89e8cf54eaf2b8df1b9bcf4bc3e37.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Trivia: Chemistry & Uncommon Words 3[/h2][hr][/hr][p]Cracking new codes provides not only a calming puzzle experience but also an opportunity to discover hundreds of wise and informative sentences. Thanks to the Trivia: Chemistry & Uncommon Words 3 DLCs, you’ll learn intriguing chemistry tidbits and decipher countless rare words that will make you rethink… maybe even rethink twice or thrice! Sound exciting?[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874840/Cipheur__Trivia_Chemistry/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3571290/Cipheur__Uncommon_Words_3/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If so, get to work, decipher a new batch of messages, and hone your code-breaking skills so that no hidden message can escape your notice. Have fun![/p][p][/p][h2][/h2]

notes.title: And We Bring You.. Some Extra Achievements!
notes.content:
Our first update to Cipheur have landed:

- Added the Nightmare mode and made some changes to the Hard (since people complained some quotes were too short with the previous Hard)
- Also added a tutorial text to explain you can actually close the congratulations popup to make a screenshot if you so wish.
- Finally, introduced achievements for the completion of the free packs (no, we don't plan to add achievements for the paid packs)


Also
- Fixed the double quote in the Videogame Quotes.
- Fixed the Korean language description.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/ec723063eab0041d23860aab1a3cadabe448e96e.png[/img]
